name: Misaki Kyouko
source:
Yuuto's friend, and Kouin's girlfriend, Kyouko is an outspoken girl whose frank demeanor and caring soul endear her to everyone she meets. Summoned to Phantasmagoria, she is forced by a curse to do battle with Yuuto as an Etranger of the Malorigan Republic.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
